articles.summary: Play Money uses Modern Treasury's Payments API to collect investor payments, distribute payouts to founders, and maintain a real-time ledger of every transaction across its platform.
articles.title: Play Money Selects Modern Treasury to Power Payments for Its Angel Investing Platform

articles.summary: Fuze Finance selects Modern Treasury to power its U.S. expansion with named U.S. accounts, stablecoin orchestration, and instant payments. One API connects users in 100+ countries to U.S. payment rails and enables conversion between dollars and stablecoins.
articles.title: Fuze Finance Partners With Modern Treasury's Payments Infrastructure for U.S. Expansion

articles.summary: Homegrown selects Modern Treasury’s Payments API to power growth capital disbursements and revenue-share repayments for multi-unit businesses. One integration brings together ACH, wire, RTP, FedNow, sub-accounts, and real-time ledgering to track funds from disbursement through repayment.
articles.title: Homegrown Selects Modern Treasury’s Payment Service Provider for Its Growth Capital Platform

articles.summary: Modern Treasury has has submitted an application to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (“OCC”) to establish Modern Treasury National Trust Bank.
articles.title: Modern Treasury Applies to Establish National Trust Bank
